newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Bank Handlowy rates PPAB as hold.
newsitem.headline: Polish Bank Handlowy rates PPAB as hold.

text.p: The brokerage unit of Polish Bank Handlowy SA gave First Polish-Amercian Bank SA (PPABank) a hold rating, forecasting it would improve its financial results in 1996 and 1997, Handlowy said in a report.
The report, released on Monday and dated July 26, said that the bank's higher interest and operational costs depressed its net profit in 1995.

Handlowy saw PPABank's net profit rising this year to 6.0 million zlotys from last year's 3.5 million thanks to a successful issue of 1.25 million shares earlier this year. It expected PPABank's net to rise to 8.4 million in 1997.
It expected PPABank net profit from interest to grow to 21.5 million zlotys this year and 28.0 million zlotys in 1997, from 13.5 million zlotys in 1995.
The report also noted the dynamic growth of PPABank's credit portfolio during 1992-1995, which was higher than the average in the sector, and said it was likely to continue.
"We believe that the dynamics of PPABank's credit portfolio growth will continue to remain high, which should contribute to a rise in the bank's income," it said.
On Monday PPABank closed at 18.3 zlotys.
